title: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL announces Extended Support minor versions 13.23-rds.20260819, 12.22-rds.20260820 and 11.22-rds.20260822
summary: Discover more about what's new at AWS with Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL announces Extended Support minor versions 13.23-rds.20260819, 12.22-rds.20260820 and 11.22-rds.20260822
body_markdown:
[Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) for PostgreSQL](https://aws.amazon.com/rds/postgresql/) announces Amazon RDS Extended Support minor versions 13.23-rds.20260819, 12.22-rds.20260820 and 11.22-rds.20260822.


[Amazon RDS Extended Support](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/extended-support.html) provides up to three additional years of fixes for critical Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) and bugs beyond a major version's end of standard support date, giving you more time to upgrade to a new major version.


You can upgrade your database using[Amazon RDS Blue/Green Deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/blue-green-deployments.html) , in-place upgrade, or restore from a snapshot. Learn more about performing version upgrades in the[Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_UpgradeDBInstance.PostgreSQL.html) .


Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL makes it simple to set up, operate, and scale PostgreSQL deployments in the cloud. Create or update a fully managed Amazon RDS database in the[Amazon RDS Management Console](https://console.aws.amazon.com/rds/) or by using the AWS Command Line Interface (AWS CLI).
